_doc: Shared cases for output_column_name (Python scifor/outputs.py, MATLAB +scifor/output_column_name.m). A 'class' case names a fixture class: Python builds it from 'column_name' (omitted attribute when null); MATLAB has a classdef of that name in scimatlab/tests/matlab/helpers. See docs/claude/for-each-kwarg-parity.md.
